de: King Narai nominates Phetracha as regent, leading to the revolution of 1688 in which Phetracha becomes king of the Ayutthaya Kingdom.

te: The Immortal Seven issue the Invitation to William, which would culminate in the Glorious Revolution.
dz: 不朽七人向威廉发出邀请，这将在光荣革命中达到顶峰。
de: The Immortal Seven issue the Invitation to William, which would culminate in the Glorious Revolution.

dz: 阿姆斯特丹市议会投票支持奥兰治的威廉入侵英格兰，这后来成为光荣革命。
de: The city council of Amsterdam votes to support William of Orange's invasion of England, which became the Glorious Revolution.

dz: 光荣革命：奥兰治的威廉占领埃克塞特。
de: Glorious Revolution: William of Orange captures Exeter.

dz: 荷兰入侵奥兰治的威廉分舰队第二次从荷兰共和国出发,开始了1688年对英格兰的入侵.
de: The Dutch invasion fleet of William of Orange departs from the Dutch Republic for the second time, beginning the 1688 invasion of England.

t: 奥兰治亲王威廉三世在布里克森姆登陆了一支荷兰军队,从1688年入侵英格兰来挑战国王詹姆斯二世的…

dz: 奥兰治亲王威廉三世在布里克森姆登陆了一支荷兰军队,从1688年入侵英格兰来挑战国王詹姆斯二世的统治,并发动了会导致光荣革命的事件.
de: Prince William III of Orange lands a Dutch army at Brixham, beginning the 1688 invasion of England to challenge the rule of King James II and setting in motion the events that would lead to the Glorious Revolution.

t: 13个学徒男孩将德利镇的城门关上给雅各派军队.
te: 13 apprentice boys shut the gates of the town of Derry to a Jacobite army.
dz: 围攻德利:13个学徒男孩将德利镇的城门关上给雅各派军队.
de: Siege of Derry: 13 apprentice boys shut the gates of the town of Derry to a Jacobite army.

t: 英国詹姆斯二世在试图逃往法国时，将国玺扔进了泰晤士河。
te: James II of England, while trying to flee to France, throws the Great Seal of the Realm into the River Thames.
dz: 光荣革命：英国詹姆斯二世在试图逃往法国时，将国玺扔进了泰晤士河。
de: Glorious Revolution: James II of England, while trying to flee to France, throws the Great Seal of the Realm into the River Thames.

t: 威廉派军队在雷丁战役中击败雅各布派，迫使詹姆斯二世逃离英格兰。
te: Williamite forces defeat Jacobites at Battle of Reading, forcing James II to flee England.
dz: 光荣革命：威廉派军队在雷丁战役中击败雅各布派，迫使詹姆斯二世逃离英格兰。
de: Glorious Revolution: Williamite forces defeat Jacobites at Battle of Reading, forcing James II to flee England.

te: As part of the Glorious Revolution, King James II of England flees from England to Paris after being deposed in favor o…
dz: 作为光荣革命的一部分，英国国王詹姆斯二世在被废黜后，被他的女婿和侄子奥兰治的威廉和他的女儿玛丽所废黜，从英格兰逃往巴黎。
de: As part of the Glorious Revolution, King James II of England flees from England to Paris after being deposed in favor of his son-in-law and nephew, William of Orange and his daughter Mary.

te: The Dutch Guards, commanded by Count Solms, enter London and occupy the Palace of Whitehall and St James's Palace, secu…
dz: 荷兰守军由索尔姆斯伯爵指挥入驻伦敦并占领了怀特霍尔宫和圣詹姆斯宫,在1688年入侵英格兰期间为奥兰治的威廉保住了首都.
de: The Dutch Guards, commanded by Count Solms, enter London and occupy the Palace of Whitehall and St James's Palace, securing the capital for William of Orange during the 1688 invasion of England.

t: 1688年入侵英格兰期间,奥兰治的威廉三世随荷兰军队入驻伦敦.
te: William III of Orange enters London with a Dutch army during the 1688 invasion of England.
dz: 1688年入侵英格兰期间,奥兰治的威廉三世随荷兰军队入驻伦敦.
de: William III of Orange enters London with a Dutch army during the 1688 invasion of England.
